L1.rule: whitened minus euclidean top-1 at the two lowest levels, all |gap| < 0.10 => no 'limit pushed lower' claim allowed

L2.rule: any level whose whitened standard-score marginal coverage < 0.85

L3.rule: authentic (0%) acceptance outside 1-alpha +/- 0.10 => the gate is calibrated on adulterated spectra only and cannot be described as an alpha false-reject rate on authentic samples

L4.rule: euclidean top-1 also rises monotonically with level => part of the limit gain is SNR, not the metric; MAF must then be reported as a pair of curves
